issue.title: test_machine_bootstrap_help_has_no_secret_cli_value fails: argparse hyphen-wraps command-line and flat_help leaves 'command- line'
issue.description:
Fails deterministically at master 404b0e2ac2 under Python 3.14.7, both in isolation and in a batch serial run. The `sase machine bootstrap` description (src/sase/main/parser_machine.py:286) is wrapped by argparse's HelpFormatter, which breaks on hyphens, so `format_help()` emits `never accepted as a command-\nline argument.` (colorized help). `tests/main/parser_help_helpers.py::flat_help` only does `" ".join(text.split())`, which yields `command- line`, so the assertion `"never accepted as a command-line argument" in bootstrap_help` fails. The test, the description text, and `flat_help` have not changed since 2026-09-08/11; the newer argparse wrap behavior exposed a latent helper bug. This is not intermittent.

Likely fix: make `flat_help` rejoin hyphen line breaks and strip ANSI before collapsing whitespace (for example `re.sub(r"-\n\s*", "-", text)`), or assert on a hyphen-free phrase. Audit other `flat_help` callers for the same latent wrap issue.

Proposed by phase sase-1eq.5.1.5 (note #6) and phase sase-1eq.5.1.6 (note #2), both of which reproduced it on clean origin/master. Triaged by the sase-1eq.5.1 land agent, which reproduced it again at 404b0e2ac2.
